formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Number-and-Rounding Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute mid-unit check confirming B1.1, B1.2, B1.3 before fair-share work begins.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative assessment. Lets the teacher see which children can read, compare, and round to 1000 before extending to fair-share and equivalence.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can read, compare, and round numbers to 1000.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read, compare, and round numbers to 1000.
header.character_watermark: Penny in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Three numbers, three jobs. For each: write the expanded form, compare to the next number, and round to the nearest 100.

image_placeholders.description: Three rows in B&W line-art, stacked. Each row ~7in × 1.4in. Pre-fills: Row 1 — number 347, expanded slot, comparison '347 vs 374', round-to-100 slot. Row 2 — 905, expanded, '905 vs 1000', round-to-100. Row 3 — 562, expanded, '562 vs 526', round-to-100.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_THREE_ROWS: keywords (expanded, compare, round) name what the rows show.

prompts.prompt: Order these five numbers from smallest to biggest: 234, 567, 89, 800, 142.
prompts.visual_layout: Middle. Number cards plus ordering boxes.

image_placeholders.description: An ordering layout in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2in. Five number cards (234, 567, 89, 800, 142) on left in random order. Five empty boxes on right with arrows.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_ORDER: keywords (order, smallest) name what the layout asks for.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Three faces in a row. Below each: 'GOT IT!', 'ALMOST!', 'TRY AGAIN!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row, each ~1.5in across. Smile, neutral, frown.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child. Score guide: 3/3 row tasks + ordering correct = ready for Lesson 4. 2/3 row tasks = brief 1:1 conference. <2 = small-group reteach with base-ten blocks.

reflection_sheet.title: My Fraction Street Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Frankie holding a Junior Fraction Friend certificate in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Fraction Friend? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W line-art. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars left to right. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Fraction Friend!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table in B&W line-art. Each row has a question label on the left and YES/NO oval bubbles on the right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE house on Fraction Street?
prompts.visual_layout: Five house icons in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Five house icons in a row in B&W line-art: House 1000 (with 1000 on the door), Compare House (with > and <), Rounding House, Sharing House, Fraction House. Each ~1in × 1in with a selection bubble below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (houses) name the five houses.

prompts.visual_layout: Three tricky-moment cards: rounding, sharing with leftovers, equivalent fractions.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: a number-line with a rounding arrow. Card B: 18 treats and 8 plates. Card C: two pizzas — one with 1/2 shaded and one with 2/4 shaded. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (round, share, fractions) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?
prompts.visual_layout: Three forward-goal cards: numbers to 10000, multiplication facts, fraction operations.

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: 'numbers up to 10000'. Card B: '7 × 8 = ?'. Card C: '1/2 + 1/4 = ?'. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (numbers, multiplication, fractions) name the three forward-goal cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the very end of Lesson 5. Allow children to take home as a self-assessment artifact.
